idea-plugin.name: GapGPT
idea-plugin.description:
Chat with GapGPT models (GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, Qwen and more) inside IntelliJ-based IDEs, in English or Persian (Farsi), with full RTL / bidi support.

  • Talks directly to the GapGPT (OpenAI-compatible) API with your own API key (kept in the IDE's secure storage)
  • Cost of every reply and your GapGPT account balance, plus a /usage report per model
  • Streaming replies, multiple chats, and a configurable model
  • English / Persian UI (switch from the chat toolbar); write in either language and get the reply in the same one
  • Per-paragraph LTR/RTL detection, so mixed Persian/English text never breaks; bundled Vazirmatn font
  • Code blocks stay left-to-right, with Copy and Insert-at-caret buttons
  • Project rules and skills from the .gapgpt/ folder; skills are available as slash commands
  • One-click import of existing rules and skills from other AI tools' folders into .gapgpt/
  • Current file and selection are shared with the model automatically
  • @-mention project files with autocomplete; send or explain the editor selection

گفتگو با همهٔ مدل‌های گپ‌جی‌پی‌تی (GPT، Claude، Gemini، DeepSeek، Grok، Qwen و…) داخل IDE، همراه با هزینهٔ هر پاسخ و اعتبار حساب، با پشتیبانی کامل از زبان فارسی و راست‌به‌چپ؛ قوانین و اسکیل‌های پروژه از پوشهٔ .gapgpt/.
